f_ir.name: loss_margin_rank_blend_softplus_weighted_advantage_gap
f_ir.intuition: Replaced the tanh and relu hinge with smoothplus on the negative margin for smoother gradients and more novel formulation. Used advantage_gap (the difference in advantages) for the weighting factor, which better reflects the pairwise preference signal and varies more continuously than max advantage. This makes the loss sensitive to the relative margin direction and magnitude, improving learning signal quality and addressing similarity to prior losses by changing the smoothing and weighting approach.
f_ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
margin = alpha * (lpw - lpl)
smooth_margin = -margin
hinge = softplus(smooth_margin)
weight_factor = abs(adv_gap)
loss = hinge * weight_factor
if weight exists:
  loss *= weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
f_ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    margin = ops.mul(alpha, ops.sub(lpw, lpl))
    neg_margin = ops.neg(margin)
    hinge = ops.softplus(neg_margin)
    weight_factor = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    loss = ops.mul(hinge, weight_factor)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
